comparisonMethod.description: Direct source-versus-runtime pixel counts over isolated element regions using the saved canonical source, pass10, and pass11 PNGs.

changedRegions.codeChange: Added position: relative and inset-inline-start: 0.5px to .auth-role-options, translating the RTL grid by 0.5px.
The same 0.5px grid translation moved the complete card, icon, title, and body.
changedRegions.assessment: local improvement outweighed by provider-card and border regressions

changedRegions.codeChange: Changed inset-inline-start from -1px to -0.5px and added a higher-specificity disabled color of #e6e7e7.

documentedRepair.measuredDefect: The pass11 0.5px .auth-role-options translation caused a net 160-pixel material regression in the combined card region.
documentedRepair.codeRepair: Remove only position: relative and inset-inline-start: 0.5px from .auth-role-options; retain the independently beneficial CTA -0.5px placement and #e6e7e7 disabled label override.
documentedRepair.expectedVisualEffect: Restore pass10 role-card geometry while preserving the measured 81-pixel CTA improvement. Under deterministic rendering, the predicted material count is 21,111 pixels, approximately 1.4181% of the 1,488,688 compared pixels.

status.nextAction: Pass12 is the single accepted recapture. AUTH-02 remains blocked on coordinator-owned visual baselines; do not recapture or advance.
